versions.changelog:
Initial release: cron-expression-helper provides an interactive toolkit for creating, validating, and explaining cron expressions.

- Create cron expressions through guided Q&A or command-line arguments
- Validate cron syntax and display recent execution times
- Generate human-readable explanations of cron schedules
- Supports both standard (5-field) and extended cron formats
- Includes example usages and full command documentation in SKILL.md
